column1: # id<TAB>sources (comma-separated, "-" = none)<TAB>shell command, run in /lab by run-capture.sh

column3: gcc --version | head -1; perf version; bpftrace --version; echo "kernel $(uname -r)"; echo "cpus $(nproc)"; ./probe.sh | grep -E '^(PROBE|    )'
make -s f1-where-time-goes && ./f1-where-time-goes
make -s f1-where-time-goes && perf stat -e task-clock,context-switches,cpu-migrations ./f1-where-time-goes 2>&1 >/dev/null | grep -v '^ *$'
make -s 00-baseline && ./00-baseline
make -s 00-baseline && bpftrace -o /tmp/bt.out -c ./00-baseline bt/stages.bt ./00-baseline >/dev/null && cat /tmp/bt.out
make -s 01-hot-path && ./compare.sh 01-hot-path
make -s 01-hot-path && perf stat -e task-clock,cycles,instructions,context-switches ./01-hot-path 2>&1 >/dev/null | grep -v '^ *$'

make -s 01-hot-path && perf record -q -F 999 -g -o /tmp/p.data ./01-hot-path >/dev/null 2>&1 && perf report -i /tmp/p.data --stdio --no-children --sort comm,sym --percent-limit 2 -g caller,0.5,callee --stdio 2>/dev/null | grep -v -e '^$' -e '^# *$' | head -40

make -s 01-hot-path && perf record -q -F 999 --call-graph dwarf -o /tmp/p.data ./01-hot-path >/dev/null 2>&1 && perf report -i /tmp/p.data --stdio --no-children --sort comm,sym --percent-limit 2 -g caller,0.5,callee 2>/dev/null | grep -v -e '^$' -e '^# *$' | head -30
make -s 01-hot-path && perf record -q -F 999 -g -o /tmp/p.data ./01-hot-path >/dev/null 2>&1 && perf script -i /tmp/p.data -F comm,ip,sym | awk -f fold-perf.awk
make -s 01-hot-path && perf record -q -F 999 -g -o /tmp/p.data ./01-hot-path --fixed >/dev/null 2>&1 && perf script -i /tmp/p.data -F comm,ip,sym | awk -f fold-perf.awk

make -s 01-hot-path && perf record -q -F 999 -g -o /tmp/p.data ./01-hot-path --fixed >/dev/null 2>&1 && perf script -i /tmp/p.data -F comm,ip,sym | awk -f fold-perf.awk | grep -E ';spf_(extract_min|relax) [0-9]+$'
make -s 02-lock && ./compare.sh 02-lock
make -s 02-lock && perf record -q -F 999 -g -o /tmp/p.data ./02-lock >/dev/null 2>&1 && perf script -i /tmp/p.data -F comm,ip,sym | awk -f fold-perf.awk

make -s 02-lock && rm -f /tmp/maps && PKTD_MAPS=/tmp/maps bpftrace -o /tmp/bt.out -c ./02-lock bt/offcpu.bt ./02-lock >/dev/null && ./symbolize.py /tmp/maps < /tmp/bt.out | awk -v map=@offcpu_us -f fold-bt.awk

make -s 02-lock && rm -f /tmp/maps && PKTD_MAPS=/tmp/maps bpftrace -o /tmp/bt.out -c ./02-lock bt/lock-wait.bt ./02-lock >/dev/null && ./symbolize.py /tmp/maps < /tmp/bt.out | tee /tmp/sym.out && awk '/^@held_total_us\[pktd-cli, *$/ {p=1} p && /^\]: / {print "cli_held_us=" $2; exit}' /tmp/sym.out

make -s 02-lock && rm -f /tmp/maps && PKTD_MAPS=/tmp/maps bpftrace -o /tmp/bt.out -c './02-lock --fixed' bt/lock-wait.bt ./02-lock >/dev/null && ./symbolize.py /tmp/maps < /tmp/bt.out | tee /tmp/sym.out && awk '/^@held_total_us\[pktd-cli, *$/ {p=1} p && /^\]: / {print "cli_held_us=" $2; exit}' /tmp/sym.out
make -s 03-syscalls && ./compare.sh 03-syscalls

make -s 03-syscalls && perf trace -s -o /tmp/tr ./03-syscalls >/dev/null && awk '/^ pktd-(push|fib) /{p=1} /^ pktd-(ctl|spf) /{p=0} p' /tmp/tr | grep -E '^ pktd-|^   (syscall|---)|^ +\(msec\)|^   (read|write|futex) '

make -s 03-syscalls && perf trace -s -o /tmp/tr ./03-syscalls --fixed >/dev/null && awk '/^ pktd-(push|fib) /{p=1} /^ pktd-(ctl|spf) /{p=0} p' /tmp/tr | grep -E '^ pktd-|^   (syscall|---)|^ +\(msec\)|^   (read|write|futex) '
make -s 03-syscalls && bpftrace -o /tmp/bt.out -c ./03-syscalls bt/syscalls.bt ./03-syscalls >/dev/null && awk '/^@calls/ {print} /^@read_us\[pktd-push\]/ {p=1} p && /^$/ {exit} p' /tmp/bt.out
make -s 04-sched && ./compare.sh 04-sched

make -s 04-sched && bpftrace -o /tmp/bt.out -c ./04-sched bt/runqlat.bt ./04-sched > /tmp/run.out && awk '/^@runq_total_us/ {print} /^@runq_us\[pktd-spf\]/ {p=1} p && /^$/ {exit} p' /tmp/bt.out && echo '--- the same run, as the lab reports it:' && grep -E '^(budget  compute|schedstat  (thread|pktd-spf) )' /tmp/run.out && awk '/^@runq_total_us\[pktd-spf\]/ {b=$2} /^schedstat  pktd-spf / {s=$4*1000} END {printf "bpftrace/schedstat=%.2f\n", b/s}' /tmp/bt.out /tmp/run.out

make -s 04-sched && perf record -q -e sched:sched_switch,sched:sched_wakeup -o /tmp/s.data ./04-sched >/dev/null 2>&1 && perf sched timehist -i /tmp/s.data 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^ +time|pktd-spf\[[0-9]+/' | head -24
make -s 05-throttle && ./compare.sh 05-throttle
make -s 05-throttle && perf stat -e task-clock,context-switches ./05-throttle 2>&1 >/dev/null | grep -v '^ *$'
make -s 05-throttle && perf record -q -F 999 -g -o /tmp/p.data ./05-throttle >/dev/null 2>&1 && perf script -i /tmp/p.data -F comm,ip,sym | awk -f fold-perf.awk
make -s 05-throttle && bpftrace -o /tmp/bt.out -c ./05-throttle bt/hold.bt ./05-throttle >/dev/null && cat /tmp/bt.out
make -s 06-boss && perf record -q -F 999 -g -o /tmp/p.data ./06-boss >/dev/null 2>&1 && perf script -i /tmp/p.data -F comm,ip,sym | awk -f fold-perf.awk

make -s 06-boss && for f in none push push,hot push,hot,lock all; do if [ $f = none ]; then ./06-boss; else ./06-boss --fix=$f; fi; done > /tmp/seq; cat /tmp/seq; awk '/^fixes applied/{f=$3} /^pktd route/{if(f=="")f="none"} /^budget  [a-z]/ && $2!="stage"{s=$4+0; if(s>top){top=s; st=$2}} /^converged_ms=/{printf "summary  fixes=%-15s converged_ms=%-9s largest=%s (%.1f%%)\n", f, substr($0,14), st, top; f=""; top=0}' /tmp/seq

make -s 06-boss && rm -f /tmp/maps && PKTD_MAPS=/tmp/maps bpftrace -o /tmp/bt.out -c './06-boss --fix=push,hot' bt/lock-wait.bt ./06-boss >/dev/null && ./symbolize.py /tmp/maps < /tmp/bt.out | tee /tmp/sym.out && awk '/^@held_total_us\[pktd-cli, *$/ {p=1} p && /^\]: / {print "cli_held_us=" $2; exit}' /tmp/sym.out
